g.title: CO_Poisoning_QSP
g.text: Carbon Monoxide Poisoning — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
Two occupancies, two clocks: carboxyhaemoglobin is fast and measured; cytochrome c oxidase is slow and unmeasured.
45-ODE mrgsolve model · 152 nodes · 17 mechanistic clusters · Coburn–Forster–Kane pulmonary exchange coupled to a bistable autoimmune demyelination switch
